text:
Maria: Plan to enable polaris-7b-quant in catalog during tonight's 02:00 UTC change window. Canary then gradual fanout. Calling ops/infra/owners for readiness.
aj: I'll reserve 8 slots in eu-west-1 and a small burst pool. Posting IDs in a sec.
Sam: I'll watch latency and error groups. Added a quick eval job for answer-quality, will post diffs.
Ben: Fallback ordering suggestion: polaris-7b-quant -> polaris-7b-fp16 -> comet-13b -> fallback-generic. TTL debate: propose 20m to avoid flapping.
Lina: From model QA: quant passes our blind eval on 95/100 cases, but long-context cases have occasional scoring drift. Recommend routing long-context to fp16 during initial 24h.
Maria: Let's add an explicit routing exception for long-context workloads to fp16 for the first day. Keep fallback TTL at 30m for stability this time. We'll revisit.
aj: slot IDs: eu-slot-42, eu-slot-43, eu-slot-44, eu-slot-45, eu-slot-46, eu-slot-47, eu-slot-48, eu-slot-49. Burst pool +1 node if mem pressure > 80%.
deploy-bot: Preflight scheduled 01:40 UTC. Running schema check, quant-compat, smoke perf.
ops-runbook-bot: Rollout thermostat: on rollback, hold at 0% for 3m. Eviction grace: 45s to drain KV caches.
Maria: Rollback triggers (finalized): 5xx > 0.4% sustained for 8m OR p95 latency +1.5s over baseline for 5m OR quality-regression on eval > 3 prompts. If triggered, pin to polaris-7b-fp16 and throttle quant to 0.
Sam: Alerts created: ru_model_5xx_eu, ru_model_latency_p95_eu, ru_model_quality_regressions. I'll link runbooks now.
Lina: Note: updated model card in release docs with long-context caveat.
release-coordinator: Release notes uploaded: https://internal.redwood/release/2026-03-21/polaris-quant-enable (includes QA signoffs, canary plan).
deploy-bot: Preflight done at 01:44 UTC 
- Warnings: slot eu-slot-46 mem at 82% -> infra to bump.
aj: Bumped node pool, rechecked slots. All green at 01:52 UTC.
deploy-bot: Canary start at 02:00:10 UTC -> routing 0.5% traffic to polaris-7b-quant in eu-west-1.
Sam: 02:06 UTC: p95 +60ms, no 5xx. Eval shows 1 minor quality diff flagged (non-blocking). Proceed to 2.5%.
Ben: I've applied the long-context exception routing rule to send those flows to fp16. Documented in release notes.
deploy-bot: Ramp to 2.5% at 02:15:00 UTC. Observation window 7m for canary increments.
Sam: 02:23 UTC: holding. No 5xx. p95 stable on short queries, small p95 tail on 2 long prompts (routed to fp16).
Lina: QA: running curated stress tests now, will report within window.
ops-runbook-bot: Quick rollback commands for oncall:
redwoodctl catalog pin --model polaris-7b-fp16 --catalog-version 2026-03-21T02
redwoodctl runtime evict --tag polaris-7b-quant --region eu-west-1 --grace 45s
redwoodctl routing set --model polaris-7b-quant --traffic 0

Maria: If rollback happens, ops will pin and we will open an incident channel. Postmortem within 24h.
Sam: 02:30 UTC: proceeding to 15% (no red flags). Will keep quality checks enabled and post per-ramp update.
aj: infra note: slot eu-slot-46 showed transient GC during 02:18-02:20; added swap and bumped OOM margin. Slots reserved until 04:00 UTC.
deploy-bot: Ramp to 15% at 02:31:45 UTC.
Sam: 02:40 UTC: token-cost +3.5% (expected). p95 stable. Quality diffs minor and within guard thresholds. Proceed to full regional fanout in 20m if stable.
Ben: For completeness, adding a short-duration override for debug traces on canary variant for next 30m. Will disable after rollout completes.
Maria: Fine, but keep traces sampling low to avoid cost.
ops-runbook-bot: Note: thermostat will prevent immediate re-enable for 10m after a rollback to avoid oscillation.
Sam: 02:50 UTC thumbs-up 2: proceed to regional fanout at 02:52 UTC.
deploy-bot: Fanout started at 02:52:03 UTC. Routed remaining 85% to polaris-7b-quant across eu-west-1 and eu-central-1.
Sam: 03:00 UTC: post-fanout check: no increase in 5xx, p95 within 200ms of baseline. Quality signals stable.
Maria: Rollout complete. I'll file the brief postmortem with charts tomorrow morning. Thanks all.
Ben: Follow-up idea: consider lowering fallback TTL to 25m for next rollout; we'll A/B test.
Lina: Reminder: monitor long-context traffic for 24h and schedule a re-eval at 48h.
Maria: Noted. Great work. :sparkles:
